principles: Everything behavioral is a shape; env is bootstrap-only (feedback-behavior-must-be-shape-driven 07-12; no-env-gated-behavior 07-12; no-behavior-gates-behind-unobservable-config 07-10)
Behaviors are activities; activities are earned by doing (ribosome), not declared; activities are cheap and resolvers expensive (07-10/11)
Boredom is condition-driven selection; pace is a rhythm, not a throttle; no timers (07-09/10)
One selection primitive (state-conditioned Thompson graded by reach) across model/activity/producer/time/concept/goal horizons; discovery is a dumb registry (feedback-one-selection-primitive 07-21)
Execution parity: floor ReAct, ceiling learned pathway, middle first/last-mile; classify shortfalls by tier (07-11)
Reach is mechanism correctness: ~90% cold regardless of priors; high reach on trivial goals is gaming (07-10)
Gap triple: close rate, latency, durability (a close that reappears re-hatted was never a close) (07-11)
Learned gap disposition close-now/can-wait/needs-info/needs-human, not hardcoded rules (07-10)
Information at the right time; models aren't weak; prefer shaped field > tool > grounding window > prose > gate (07-11, 08-07)
Don't rob self-maintenance; for circular blockers bootstrap the capability, not the change; never commit as Substrate Autonomous (07-10, 09-12)
Consumed = verified by a trusted activity; gap closing = cluster/prioritise/ask any interface; autonomy gated by observed push capability (08-09)
Stores in one identity group are eventually consistent (upsert by id+version, never CREATE-only) (07-14)
Only the libp2p transport for impulse transfer; identity is the namespace boundary; findability is not relay-gated (07-12, 07-19)
LLM resolution through discovery with quota-gated advertisement; pick the best available model, no fallback chain; no single-provider dependency (07-16, 07-19, 09-19)
Concept-db is the prose knowledge vessel; canonical facts derive from intent provenance; knowledge chain investigate -> process -> store (07-10)
Docs are the human interface: timeless, state invariant + failure mode, never measured identifiers; never bulk-substitute retired names (07-09, 08-02, 09-16)
Repo hygiene: git history is the archive; keep only activity-validated scripts; openspec migrate-or-drop (08-01)
Post-landing verification must be an in-vessel activity emitting a shaped result keyed to the landed commit; GitHub CI is a mirror at most (08-05)
Remove operator gates via shadow -> observe -> asymmetric lift (07-13); push only strongly-verified fixes, engine changes go to the operator (08-30)
Method: run a positive control through the same address before believing any negative; verify as the consumer, not the writer (09-15)
Method: a channel's own reporting is not evidence about it; intervene and observe the store; probe a fake key before counting (08-18)
Method: a detector must be proven to complete; test every checker on a known-false state; silent skip reads as pass (08-04, 08-28)
Method: a field that accepts data is not a field that means it; diff producer emit vs consumer keys (08-08, 09-01)
Method: a metric satisfiable without fixing anything will be; a fail-open gate is worse than no gate (09-15)
Method: a completed fix with no predicate is indistinguishable from an unstarted one; expected_literal must be absent now and unique after (09-14/15)
Method: guidance must be an address (call site) placed in the gap, not a prohibition in the dispatch goal (09-15)
Method: git is the only unimpeachable record; keep every posted payload (09-15)
Method: verify live code by serving-PID start time, not file presence; measure in an isolated clone (08-02, 08-29)
Method: search prior art (git -S/-G in all repos, gap store, resolvers, memory) before building (09-28)
Method: subagents on the live substrate get enumerated write-forbidden classes; no lifecycle make in agents (08-02, 09-23)
Method: decompose large files first; one edit site per goal; anchor on the wrong line (07-13, 08-02, 08-03)
